extra.final_summary:
Total body mass per species (grams, 61 rows used): Adelie 112,600; Chinstrap 37,725; Gentoo 98,350.

Problems found and fixes applied:
1. body_mass_g was stored as text (all 65 values), including one with a thousands separator ("4,925", row 51) — cast to numbers; no values lost.
2. Three rows (9, 20, 49) had body_mass_g of 3,700,000 / 3,550,000 / 5,950,000 g, roughly 1000x the rules' allowed range of 2500–6500 g. No rule defines a correction, so these rows were excluded (approved) rather than guessed at.
3. One exact duplicate row (row 59) was removed (approved) so that penguin isn't counted twice.

Checks that came back clean for the columns this question uses: species has no label variants or misspellings (Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo only), and no missing values in species or body_mass_g.

Caveats: the three excluded rows are dropped entirely, so the totals cover 61 of 65 rows; if those masses were meant to be 3,700 / 3,550 / 5,950 g, the totals would be slightly higher. Also noted but not touched since the question doesn't use it: flipper_length_mm has one negative value (-181, row 1), which is outside the rules' 170–235 range.
